method: Playwright, installed Chrome, headless; Browser plugin absent
checks: Title, fonts and WebGL scene load
Settings opens and Escape closes its modal
Keyboard start, countdown, forward motion and first core growth
Pause freezes HUD and gameplay resources
Save & Exit persists an exact active snapshot
Focus loss freezes a resume countdown
All four HUD groups stay inside 1280×720 at 150% scale
Real movement into the arena wall produces named critical crash
Terminal result records once and clears the suspend
Retry restores the district entry checkpoint
Local Records displays the real saved result
Narrow title remains contained (touch gameplay is outside target)
Explicit Warden fixture restores and renders real relays, nodes and HUD
No uncaught browser or console errors across these flows
limitations: Warden screenshot uses an explicit snapshot fixture, not a full playthrough.
Controller hardware, subjective audio and five-district launch acceptance are not established.
